repo_notes.content: Bash + jq toolchain that migrates Docker containers created by vendor UIs (Synology Container Manager), docker run, or other tooling into reviewed per-container Docker Compose projects without data loss. lib/list_containers.sh and lib/container_recreate.sh are derived from the MIT-licensed synology-docker project (see NOTICE). Repo: https://github.com/gundestrup/stateful-docker-migration-flow

Safety invariants the wiki must get right: named volumes and networks are emitted 'external: true' (reused, never recreated), anonymous volumes are preserved unless --fresh-anonymous-volumes is passed, environment values go only into a mode-600 .env file (never stdout or the manifest), edited output is never overwritten (*.generated candidates plus a diff), and a typed RECREATE confirmation is required before docker stop/rm — rm is never invoked with -v.

Entry point is 'sdmf' (interactive menu + non-interactive subcommands: doctor, list, next, export-all, validate, recreate, manifest) — the only root-level executable; implementation scripts live in lib/. lib/list_containers.sh = inventory, export orchestration, and the private compose-export-manifest.json; lib/export_to_compose.sh = docker-inspect / Synology-JSON to Compose+env converter; lib/container_recreate.sh = best-effort docker run hint with secrets redacted; lib/platform.sh = synology/truenas/linux detection and runtime/compose abstraction (SDMF_PLATFORM, DOCKER_BIN, MIGRATION_ROOT).

Two test tiers: tests/run.sh mocked regression suite (Debian + jq image, stubbed docker CLI, kcov line coverage in CI) and tests/e2e.sh on docker:dind which runs a real dockerd, simulates Synology's removed 'db' logger by rewriting hostconfig.json, and asserts named-volume, bind-mount, env, and restart-policy data survive migration.
See AGENTS.md for full project context, conventions, and quality gates.
